subjects.name: Indian Polity
subjects.description: Comprehensive practice vault covering Constitutional Framework, Rights, Parliament, Judiciary, Federalism & Adda247 Selection Tests.

topics.name: 1. The Preamble & Constitutional Philosophy
topics.description: Sovereignty, socialist, secular, democratic republic nature, justice, liberty, equality & popular sovereignty.

topics.description: Definition of State, Rule of Law, Article 19 freedoms, privacy, freedom of religion & forced labour.

topics.name: 7. Federalism & Division of Powers
topics.description: Federal and unitary features, distribution of legislative, administrative, and financial powers.

topics.name: 8. Amendment of Constitution
topics.description: Procedure for amendment under Article 368, types of majorities, and significance.
